config.eclipsestweakeroo.server_disabled: Whether to broadcast in chat which features of the mod the server has disabled (if any) when joining
config.eclipsestweakeroo.player_list_hid: Hides the player list header when the player list tweak is enabled
Hides the player list footer when the player list tweak is enabled
Hides the player list ping bars when the player list tweak is enabled
Hides the scoreboard objectives in the player list when the player list tweak is enabled
config.eclipsestweakeroo.player_list_nam: Changes player names in the player list to use fancy names when the player list tweak is enabled
config.eclipsestweakeroo.player_list_bel:
Moves the player list below any bossbars that are rendering
when the player list tweak is enabled
config.eclipsestweakeroo.player_list_ord: Changes the order of players in the player list when the player list tweak is enabled
config.eclipsestweakeroo.slipperiness: Defines how slippery every block is when using tweakSlippery
config.eclipsestweakeroo.slipperiness_af: When true, tweakSlippery affects vehicles you're riding as well
config.eclipsestweakeroo.fancy_name_elem: Defines how fancy names look. If a placeholder fails, the element will be omitted. Possible placeholders can be found in the README/Modrinth page
config.eclipsestweakeroo.jump_velocity: Defines the jump velocity override when using tweakJumpVelocity
config.eclipsestweakeroo.durability_chec: Prevents using items when they're about to run out if tweakDurabilityCheck is enabled
config.eclipsestweakeroo.durability_warn: The time to wait before reshowing a durability warning with tweakDurabilityCheck, in seconds
config.eclipsestweakeroo.command_only_ad: Target only adult pets with sitDownNearbyPets and standUpNearbyPets hotkeys
config.eclipsestweakeroo.attack_placehol:
Show critical hit damage values for players
in the attack fany name placeholder
config.eclipsestweakeroo.auto_reconnect_: The time to wait before reconnecting with tweakAutoReconnect, in milliseconds
config.eclipsestweakeroo.player_add_remo: Notifies player info additions and removals with tweakPlayerInfoNotifications
config.eclipsestweakeroo.player_gamemode: Notifies player info gamemode changes with tweakPlayerInfoNotifications
config.eclipsestweakeroo.player_listed_n: Notifies listed players changes with tweakPlayerInfoNotifications
config.eclipsestweakeroo.player_display_: Notifies player info display name changes with tweakPlayerInfoNotifications
config.eclipsestweakeroo.durability_chec: The threshold to start preventing the use of items low on durability
config.eclipsestweakeroo.spider_boat: Boats can jump infinitely high when tweakBoats is enabled
config.eclipsestweakeroo.boat_player_yaw: Boats follow the yaw of the controlling player when tweakBoats is enabled
config.eclipsestweakeroo.health_warning_: Determines when to start flashing the HP text when tweakNumberHud is used
config.eclipsestweakeroo.hunger_warning_: Determines when to start flashing the hunger text when tweakNumberHud is used
config.eclipsestweakeroo.air_warning_thr: Determines when to start flashing the air text when tweakNumberHud is used
config.eclipsestweakeroo.number_hud_dura: Shows durability warnings for equipment slots when tweakNumberHud is used
config.eclipsestweakeroo.disable_explosi: Disables knockback from explosions when disableKnockback is enabled
config.eclipsestweakeroo.gravity_overrid: Defines the gravity value when using tweakGravity
config.eclipsestweakeroo.step_height_ove: Defines the step height value when using tweakStepHeight
config.eclipsestweakeroo.fake_sneaking_l: Allows tweakFakeSneaking to stop you from falling down a ladder
config.eclipsestweakeroo.permanent_sneak: Allows tweakPermanentSneak to work while using tweakFreeCamera
config.eclipsestweakeroo.happy_ghast_cre:
Uses creative flight controls to control Happy Ghasts
when tweakHappyGhast is enabled.
Uses same speed as normally, except when sprinting.
Double-tap jump to dismount
config.eclipsestweakeroo.hide_happy_ghas: Hides the Happy Ghast when controlling it and tweakHappyGhast is enabled
config.eclipsestweakeroo.no_happy_ghast_: Disables rotating the Happy Ghast when not moving and tweakHappyGhast is enabled
config.eclipsestweakeroo.happy_ghast_rot:
Defines the rotation speed when controlling the Happy Ghast with tweakHappyGhast.
1.0 is instant rotation
config.eclipsestweakeroo.music_toast_mus:
Shows the music toast for game music when
tweakMusicToast is enabled.
When disabled, shows an actionbar text instead,
like is normally done for jukebox records
config.eclipsestweakeroo.music_toast_rec:
Shows the music toast for jukebox records when
tweakMusicToast is enabled.
When disabled, shows an actionbar text instead,
like is normally done
config.eclipsestweakeroo.music_toast_pau:
Whether to show music toasts in the pause menu when
enabled for music or jukebox records,
and tweakMusicToast is enabled
config.eclipsestweakeroo.tool_switch_bac:
Whether to switch back to the original hotbar slot
and item after breaking blocks with tweakToolSwitch enabled
config.eclipsestweakeroo.piston_flexible:
Fixes inverse rotation placement of pistons, dispensers,
droppers and crafters with tweakFlexibleBlockPlacement
(Allows placing these blocks facing away from you)
config.eclipsestweakeroo.writable_book_f:
Fixes MC-297501, allowing you to use formatting codes in books again,
and making them display as they would before 1.21.6.
Breaks the editing cursor when placed mid-text
config.eclipsestweakeroo.right_control_f:
Fixes the right control key not functioning
as control modifier in some places, like inventory screens,
resulting in dropping whole stacks not working with the
right control key
config.eclipsestweakeroo.chat_message_se:
A list of chat player name-message separators,
used by tweakChatMessages to detect when a message body starts
config.eclipsestweakeroo.tweak_player_li:
Makes various changes to the player list.
Can be configured in General
config.eclipsestweakeroo.tweak_player_na: Uses fancy names for rending the player names
config.eclipsestweakeroo.tweak_mob_names: Uses fancy names for rendering mob names, and makes them always show
config.eclipsestweakeroo.tweak_chat_mess:
Tries to disable all server chat formatting,
to make chat messages display vanilla-like
config.eclipsestweakeroo.tweak_slippery:
Overrides every block's slipperiness.
Can be configured in General. Mostly for fun
config.eclipsestweakeroo.tweak_jump_velo:
Overrides every block's jump velocity.
Can be configured in General. Also mostly for fun
config.eclipsestweakeroo.tweak_durabilit:
Adds a durability check, which displays a message when
your armor or the item you're currently using is low on durability.
Can also disable using items low on durability by configuring in General
config.eclipsestweakeroo.tweak_status_ef: Modifies the status effect HUD to show effect duration
config.eclipsestweakeroo.tweak_player_in:
Puts notifications in chat for player info changes.
Can be configured in General
config.eclipsestweakeroo.tweak_boats:
Disables boat drift on turning and allows boats to jump 1 block high
Configure further in General
config.eclipsestweakeroo.tweak_creative_:
Enables creative flight when using elytra.
May be considered cheating on some servers, use at your own risk
config.eclipsestweakeroo.tweak_render_op: Makes operator blocks like barrier and light blocks have a texture
config.eclipsestweakeroo.tweak_number_hu:
Replaces parts of the HUD with
number/text-based rendering to be more informative
config.eclipsestweakeroo.tweak_lodestone:
Enables you to see the position a lodestone compass
has targeted by right clicking it
config.eclipsestweakeroo.tweak_gravity:
Allows you to override your gravity attribute.
Can be configured in General
config.eclipsestweakeroo.tweak_step_heig:
Allows you to override your step height attribute.
Can be configured in General.
Note that this also affects sneaking
config.eclipsestweakeroo.tweak_happy_gha:
Makes various tweaks to controlling Happy Ghasts.
Requires configuring in General
config.eclipsestweakeroo.tweak_locator_b: Shows faces of players on the locator bar when applicable
config.eclipsestweakeroo.tweak_persisten: Keeps past chat messages across server/world switches
config.eclipsestweakeroo.tweak_show_form:
Renders legacy text formatting codes
with a grey colour instead of hiding them.
Still displays the formatting they set
config.eclipsestweakeroo.tweak_music_toa:
Makes a few tweaks to the music toast:
- Allows configuring whether to show a toast
  or actionbar message for game music
- Allows configuring whether to show a toast
  or actionbar message for jukebox records
- Allows configuring whether to show a toast
  on the pause screen for game music or jukebox records
Configure using the "musicToast" options in Generic
config.eclipsestweakeroo.insert_formatti: Inserts a formatting code on the open screen
config.eclipsestweakeroo.disable_fog_mod: Disables all fog modifiers (darkness, blindness, water, etc..)
config.eclipsestweakeroo.disable_armor_r: Disables the restriction armor slots have
config.eclipsestweakeroo.disable_item_co:
Disables all item cooldowns
(for items such as ender pearls, chorus fruits, etc.)
config.eclipsestweakeroo.disable_illegal: Disables the check for section characters in all text boxes
config.eclipsestweakeroo.disable_bed_exp:
Disables bed explosions in dimensions where
beds explode, by cancelling bed clicks
config.eclipsestweakeroo.disable_offhand: Disables using items in your offhand
config.eclipsestweakeroo.disable_horse_j:
Disables (always maximises) the jump charge
and cooldown on horses and similar entities
config.eclipsestweakeroo.disable_overlay:
Disables rendering the vignette, spyglass,
carved pumpkin, powder snow, and other overlays
config.eclipsestweakeroo.disable_all_nam:
Disables rendering all name tags in F1
(vanilla Minecraft still renders the names of entities in teams)
config.eclipsestweakeroo.disable_use_ite: Disables slowing down when using items, like eating food
config.eclipsestweakeroo.disable_swift_s:
Disables sneak speed modifiers like swift sneak,
because sometimes slow sneaking is nice
config.eclipsestweakeroo.disable_book_li:
Disables the line limit of books,
allowing you to write until the full limit of
1024 characters
config.eclipsestweakeroo.disable_baby_fe:
Disables feeding of baby animals,
making breeding animals easier when
there are a lot of animals in a small space
config.eclipsestweakeroo.disable_end_fla:
Disables end flashes completely,
including the flashing of the sky
and the flash textures in the sky
config.eclipsestweakeroo.client_only_war:
Note: This feature works either at all or
at least fully only in single player
config.eclipsestweakeroo.server_side_opt:
Note: On multiplayer servers, this feature,
or a subset of it, requires a server-side opt-in
